ranges_semantics: observed per-split extrema; cutpoints are in split_plan

split_plan.cut_method: campaign-forward purged blocks from per-block label counts; no features or model scores
split_plan.selection_rule: no candidate met the coverage/purge floor; maximised the number of classes present in every split, then their minimum coverage ratio, then block length
split_plan.state_isolation: graph and endpoint state reset at every segment; no context crosses a split boundary
split_plan.note: Each family trains on earlier activity than it is tested on; different families interleave in time, so this is not a single global-forward deployment claim. Use --split_scope global for that protocol.

timeout_profile.source: UQ NetFlow v3 release: flows exported in intervals of at most two minutes (nProbe active timeout 120 s, idle timeout 60 s, scan <= 1 s)

shard_paths: absolute at preparation; resolved under output_dir/prepared/<split> when relocated
